enter: Lumi pads into {place}, tail up, whiskers forward. Adventure smells a bit like dust.
{place} opens up ahead. Lumi takes a deep breath and one very brave step.
Lumi peeks into {place}, then tiptoes in as if it were someone's bedroom.
start: This is where Lumi came in. Home is just behind her, whenever she's ready.
The way home waits here, warm and patient.
Lumi is back at the entrance. She could go home now, or be brave a little longer.
empty: Nothing here but quiet. Lumi leaves a pawprint in the dust to prove she came.
An empty room. Lumi checks behind herself anyway, twice.
Lumi finds nothing at all, and decides it is a very nice nothing.
The room is bare. Lumi's glow makes soft shapes on the walls, so she watches those for a moment.
again: Lumi has been here before. Her pawprints say so.
This room again. It hasn't changed, and neither has Lumi.
Lumi passes back through, humming the tune she made up last time.
treasure: Lumi spots something shiny and pounces: {item}!
Tucked in a corner, just for her: {item}. Lumi purrs.
Lumi noses under a loose stone and finds {item}. Into the satchel it goes.
key: A little key, glinting on the floor. Lumi holds it very carefully in her teeth.
Lumi finds a key. Somewhere on this floor, a door is about to be surprised.
Something jingles under Lumi's paw. A key!
vault: The door swings open. Inside, glowing softly: {item}. Lumi's eyes go very round.
Lumi steps into the vault and finds {item}. She does a small, dignified dance.
Behind the lock, waiting all this time: {item}.
locked_key: A sturdy door with a keyhole just Lumi's size. It will not budge without a key.
Locked. Lumi pats the keyhole politely, but it wants a key.
This door needs a key. Lumi is sure there's one somewhere on this floor.
locked_puzzle: The door is sealed by a puzzle. Lumi sits down, tail curled, to think.
No keyhole here, only a puzzle. Lumi narrows her eyes at it.
A puzzle guards this door. Lumi cracks her tiny knuckles.
game_cups: Three cups sit in a row. Something rattled under one of them, Lumi is certain.
Somebody has left three cups and a mystery. Lumi's tail twitches.
Three cups, one prize. Lumi stares at each in turn, very seriously.
game_match: Cards lie face down in neat rows, each hiding a little picture. Lumi loves a matching game.
A set of cards waits to be paired up. Lumi wiggles, ready.
Face-down cards cover the floor. Two of each, somewhere.
game_win: Lumi wins! She gets {item}, and looks around to see if anyone noticed.
A perfect game. {item} for Lumi, who is trying hard not to look smug.
Lumi got it! Her prize is {item}.
game_lose: Not this time. Lumi gets {item} for being a good sport.
Lumi didn't win, but she had fun, and there's {item} for trying.
So close! Lumi takes {item} and a small bow.
enemy: A wild {enemy} hops into the way! Lumi fluffs up to twice her size.
Something rustles. A {enemy}! Lumi plants her paws.
A {enemy} blocks the path and does not look like moving. Lumi's glow brightens.
victory: The {enemy} scampers off, and Lumi gives her paw a satisfied lick.
Lumi wins! The {enemy} bounces away to think about what it's done.
Off goes the {enemy}. Lumi stands a little taller.
fled: Lumi darts back the way she came. The {enemy} can have that room for now.
A tactical retreat. Lumi catches her breath one room back, well away from the {enemy}.
Lumi decides the {enemy} can wait, and trots smartly backwards.
defeat: The {enemy} was too much today. Lumi is carried home for a nap, and her satchel stays behind.
Lumi wobbles, yawns, and is gently carried home. What she found is still down there, past the {enemy}.
Worn out by the {enemy}, Lumi heads home empty-pawed. She'll be back.
stairs: Stairs, winding down into the dark. Lumi peers over the edge.
Lumi finds a staircase going deeper. It looks harder down there, and shinier.
Here are the stairs. Down means tougher creatures and better treasure.
descend: Down she goes, one careful step at a time. The air is different here.
Lumi hops down the last stair onto a new floor. No going back up that way.
A deeper floor. Lumi's glow seems brighter against the dark.
home: Lumi trots out of {place} and all the way home, satchel bumping happily at her side.
Home! Lumi tips out her satchel on the rug and admires every single thing.
Lumi leaves {place} behind, a little tired and very pleased.
abandon: Lumi has had enough for today. She leaves her finds behind and heads for home.
Home sounds nicer than any treasure. Lumi sets down her satchel and goes.
Lumi turns for home with empty paws and no regrets.
potion: Lumi drinks a potion. It tastes like warm berries, and she feels much better.
Glug. Lumi shakes out her fur, good as new.
One potion later, Lumi's glow is steady again.
look: Lumi looks closer. Someone scratched a tiny pawprint into the wall, long ago, about her size.
There is a draught from somewhere. Lumi follows it with her whiskers and finds only a crack and a cobweb.
A pebble sits in the exact middle of the floor. Lumi suspects it of something and watches it for a while.
The dust here has footprints in it that are not hers. They go to the wall and stop. Lumi decides not to mind.
Lumi sniffs the corner. It smells of old stone, cold air, and very faintly of biscuits.
Her glow throws a second, bigger Lumi on the wall. They wave at each other.
